fields.summary_ko.0: GF Securities lowered Dell Technologies (DELL) target price from $497 to $341, a 30% reduction ahead of November 24 earnings announcement
fields.summary_ko.1: AI server strength in near term expected to drive quarterly revenue of $5.4B and EPS of $7.18, but enterprise server shipments projected to decline 9% from 2027 onwards
fields.summary_ko.2: General enterprise server shipments expected to decline double-digits in H2 2027, PC shipments anticipated to decline single-digits in 2028, suggesting weak medium to long-term growth
